## How engagements run

**Advisory** — A few sessions to scope an AI-agent architecture, review your evaluation strategy, or pressure-test a plan. Good for teams that have the people but want a second opinion from someone who has done it before.

**Hands-on AI engineering** — I build the thing: agents, guardrails, evals, tool contracts. I write code, not slide decks.

**Embedded principal / interim lead** — I join your team for weeks or months as a senior IC or interim lead. I own deliverables, coordinate with stakeholders, and ship alongside your people. This is how most of my enterprise engagements run.

Whatever the form, delivery is evaluation-first: a success criterion agreed up front, correctness proved before optimization, and evidence shown before anything ships.

## Good fit

- You are **building AI agents against real data** — analytics agents, Text-to-SQL, RAG over schemas — and need someone who has shipped agentic systems with evaluation discipline, not just prompts.
- You have an agent in use and **cannot say how often it is right**. You need an eval suite, tracing, and a failure analysis you can act on.
- You want **coding agents on real engineering work** — a code migration, a platform migration, a pipeline redesign — with tests that decide what ships.
- You are **driving AI adoption** and need someone to run discovery, align stakeholders, and take agentic PoCs to production.
- You need an **interim team lead** who can own a roadmap, manage stakeholders, and still write code.
- You have a **time series or telemetry problem** that needs production ML, not a research paper.

I typically work with enterprise teams in manufacturing, logistics, energy, and industrial IoT, but the methods transfer.
